surface.background: fully opaque deep blueprint-blue drafting ground based on #123B66
surface.alternate: warm drafting paper inversion is allowed for non-golden article variants only
surface.finish: matte technical drafting surface with one low-intensity construction grid

palette_roles.final_structure: pale blue-white based on #E6F4FF defines final orthographic structure
palette_roles.construction: muted steel blue based on #82A8C8 defines ghost and construction lines
palette_roles.thesis_highlight: a single cyan based on #72D5FF identifies exactly one supported boundary layer or transition
palette_roles.secondary_boundary: deep muted blue based on #2A5278 separates subordinate drafting regions without creating a second accent
palette_roles.ground: deep blueprint-blue remains the dominant visual field

line_language.primary: uniform two-pixel pale lines with disciplined mechanical continuity
line_language.construction: uniform two-pixel or visually lighter dashed construction lines aligned to the drafting grid
line_language.arrows: orthogonal two-pixel arrows with small unglowed heads and no perspective foreshortening
line_language.boundaries: flat orthographic outlines sections cutaways and exploded alignment guides

material_and_texture.surface: opaque matte blueprint ground with a restrained low-contrast square grid
material_and_texture.objects: line-led technical structures with no glossy solid material rendering
material_and_texture.depth: almost volumeless flat cutaway; ghost layers clarify alignment without creating spatial scenery

geometry.grid: twenty-pixel drafting grid with measured spacing and seventy-two-pixel outer margins
geometry.projection: orthographic elevation plan section cutaway or exploded alignment only
geometry.nodes: flat two-pixel technical outlines with two-pixel corners and open drafting captions
geometry.grouping: construction boundaries and measured spacing group content without cards dashboards or decorative containers
geometry.focal_rule: one large supported boundary layer component relation or frozen-graph path carries the thesis

depth_and_camera.mode: strict orthographic camera with no perspective convergence
depth_and_camera.volume: almost no volume; section offsets and ghost layers remain coplanar
depth_and_camera.lighting: none; no glow cast shadow dramatic light or material highlight

typography.voice: restrained monospace drafting captions in deterministic annotation zones
typography.exact_text: titles labels dimensions and technical prose are applied deterministically only after semantics are confirmed
typography.generated_text: image generation leaves annotation zones blank and never invents dimensions identifiers or labels

density_and_spacing.density: medium-disciplined line density with one complete technical subject rather than an empty grid or decorative machinery
density_and_spacing.spacing: measured grid-aligned gaps and generous outer margins keep every boundary legible at article width
density_and_spacing.occupancy: cover and concept subjects occupy roughly seventy-six to eighty-four percent while deterministic diagrams preserve all graph elements inside the outer eight percent safe region

required_traits: deep blueprint-blue ground dominates every golden reference
strict orthographic projection and uniform two-pixel pale linework remain visible at article width
a single cyan highlight carries one confirmed semantic boundary layer or transition
low-intensity drafting grid construction hierarchy and measured spacing create technical discipline
complete subject occupancy prevents empty blueprint paper with tiny decorative line art
forbidden_traits: no fake dimensions tolerances pseudo-engineering identifiers decorative measurements or invented technical labels
no isometric camera perspective distortion matte spatial solids directional shadows glossy materials photorealism or cinematic lighting
no dense crosshatching decorative machinery dashboard chrome card grids neon glow or multiple cyan accents
no loose graphite wobble translucent watercolor wash familiar-object teaching metaphor or playful doodle contour
no unsupported nodes edges ports layers connections or article topology

neighbor_boundaries.difference: Style 4 is flat orthographic line-led and almost volumeless; Style 5 uses a fixed 30-degree isometric camera matte spatial solids ecosystem scale and directional shadows
Style 4 keeps uniform mechanically controlled drafting lines and a strict grid; Style 7 uses fine soft variable contours translucent watercolor washes warm paper and approachable physical metaphors
